While the next Closed Beta update will take a little longer than usual, the reason is simple: instead of releasing only a small patch, I am currently working on many larger improvements at the same time. events.title: Veyora Development Update – Our World Comes to Life
events.summary: Hello Adventurers! It’s time for another look behind the scenes of Veyora.Our starting region is now almost fully built and what we’re doing right now is bringing it to life. Towns are coming to life with unique characters, while enemies now roam the forests, dungeons, and open fields. At the same time, we’re developing a dynamic sound system that adds atmosphere and depth to every part of the world. With the evolving day–night rhythm and shifting weather, Veyora is starting to feel truly alive.
